{{Top|leg}}
The '''Archive system''' was a [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] network of intelligence gathering and data collation centers. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Breslin Drake]] oversaw the development of the system, but it was compromised by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] known as [[the Wraith]].
